fact: The HAAC's decision 25-083 of 9 December 2025, for the 11 January 2026 legislative and communal elections, forbids manipulation of statements or information through uncontrolled and irresponsible use of AI, with sanctions up to suspension from the campaign.
title: Campagne médiatique pour les législatives et communales 2026 au Bénin : intégralité de la décision de la HAAC
